Notes for the publisher

  • Click-through: bestluxuryproperties.com via var clickTag in the head, with UTM tags per size (utm_campaign=blp_brand_guy). The ad server can overwrite clickTag.
  • No external requests. Fonts (Domaine Display, Poppins) are embedded, images are embedded WebP.
  • Animation runs once and settles by about 2.5 seconds, no loop.
  • RERA ORN 22588 is shown on the 970 × 250. Static JPG fallbacks are available per size.
